answer: Equivocation-proof bond stops one operator faking faces. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a ledge, one yarrow stalk per epoch. A claim on the dune spends the stalk: one identity, one flag. Two flags from one key prove equivocation, the bond falls off its ledge and burns, a rented stalk burning its lender too. The k-th fake costs 44+5(k-1); 1,000 pay 2,541,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once for 44, bond intact.
